instruction: My work meeting files are available in the "~/documents/work/meetings/" directory in my file system. Currently, they are organized as "<date>__<file_name>.<extension>". Reorganize them in this format, "<file_name>/<date>.<extension>".
notes: Only file_system (plus supervisor) is needed. The number of meeting files is only known at runtime from file_system.show_directory, so the model uses three placeholder files (meeting-file-1..3) as a template: instantiate one mfile, one source path, one destination path and one destination directory per file entry returned by the listing. The files are declared as domain constants so that supervisor-complete-task can list every goal condition (reorganized for each file) in its precondition without quantification; all other objects live in the problem. show_directory (with directory_path) makes the listing known; create_directory creates '<file_name>/' under the meetings directory (once per distinct target folder thanks to dir-exists; files sharing a file_name share one dirpath object); move_file moves '<date>__<file_name>.<extension>' to '<file_name>/<date>.<extension>', which preserves content as the evaluation requires. complete_task is called without an answer and is forced last via (task-completed).

plan: (file-system-move-file src-path-1 dst-path-1 file-system-token meeting-file-1 meetings-dir dst-dir-1)
(file-system-move-file src-path-2 dst-path-2 file-system-token meeting-file-2 meetings-dir dst-dir-2)
(file-system-move-file src-path-3 dst-path-3 file-system-token meeting-file-3 meetings-dir dst-dir-3)
